{{Top|leg}}
'''Mora beetles''' were huge, stinking bugs with green eyes, a giant horn on their noses, ten legs, and a scaly [[exoskeleton]] made of [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]]. This type of beetle's hiss and chitter included a noise from its horn that sounded like the word "''Flee. Flee.''" Denizens at least of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the insect's precise origins in the galaxy remain unclear.

[[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] fancied mora [[Beetle/Legends|beetles]] and was known to keep them in cages in [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|her palace]] dungeons near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on Tatooine. She retained a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] gourmet chef from [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]] who specialized in cooking [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that were bred for size and tastiness. The [[:Category:Insects|bugs]]—as part of a scientific process the Kubaz called ''[[insecticulture]]''<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>—were fed chemicals and injected with growth hormones to cause them to unnaturally mutate and increase in size to their gigantic forms.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a large mora beetle was let loose from its cage by the young [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Dorn (Bothan)|Dorn]], in an effort to cause mayhem and confusion while he and his friends, including the boy [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]], and the young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pala Kwi'teksa]], sought to free several captured [[Ghostling]] children. Gardulla planned to use these delicate and beautiful native creatures of the planet [[Datar/Legends|Datar]] as ornaments for her luxurious [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] that was then under construction. The loosed mora beetle was soon chasing not only terrorized [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean guards]] down palace passageways, but also an infuriated but panicked Gardulla herself around her pool in her palace's waterfall- and fountain-filled pool room. The beetle was eventually shot and killed with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] by the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] henchman [[Khiss (Dug)|Khiss]] as it charged to attack the Dug's professional [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] master, [[Sebulba]].<ref>''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''(pp. 83-98); ''[[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]'' (p. 5)</ref>
